summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of guided tour feature. All features working correctly - Tour does NOT auto-show on login for existing user with schools, Replay Tour button in Settings works correctly, all 9 tour steps display properly with correct titles, spotlight highlights on correct sidebar nav items, tour targets match actual data-testid attributes, Next/Back/Skip buttons work correctly, and tour_completed localStorage flag is set on tour completion.
critical_code_review_comments: Tour.js correctly defines 9 steps with accurate data-testid selectors matching Layout.js sidebar items
Layout.js properly listens for 'trigger_tour' event and checks both show_tour AND tour_completed localStorage flags
Auto-skip logic in Tour.js handles missing elements gracefully (lines 89-100)
SettingsPage.js Replay button correctly removes tour_completed, sets show_tour, and redirects to /board
EmptyBoardState.js and UniversityKnowledgeBase.js correctly trigger tour after first school added
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tour feature fully functional. Test user pro@test.com already has schools (1 school - UCLA) and tour testing was done via Replay button in Settings. Tour localStorage flags working correctly.

tour_no_auto_trigger_on_login.details: Tour does NOT auto-show when pro@test.com logs in (has schools and appropriate flags)

settings_replay_tour_button.details: Replay button in Settings > Guided Tour section works - removes tour_completed, sets show_tour, redirects to /board

tour_9_steps_display.details: All 9 steps display correctly: 1-Welcome (center), 2-Dashboard, 3-My Schools, 4-Inbox, 5-Calendar, 6-School Database, 7-AI-Powered Tools, 8-Your Profile, 9-You're all set (center)

tour_spotlight_highlights.details: Sidebar nav items correctly highlighted with pink border spotlight cutout for steps 2-8

tour_targets_match_testids.details: All tour targets verified: nav-dashboard, nav-my schools, nav-my inbox, nav-calendar, nav-find schools, nav-ai-features-toggle, profile-dropdown-trigger

tour_next_button.details: Next button advances through all 9 steps, shows 'Start Tour' on step 1, 'Next' on steps 2-8, 'Get Started' on step 9

tour_back_button.details: Back button appears on steps 2-9, successfully navigates to previous step

tour_skip_buttons.details: Step 1 has 'Skip tour' text button, all steps have X close button that dismisses tour

tour_completion_localstorage.details: After tour completion or skip: tour_completed='true' set, show_tour removed from localStorage

sidebar_testid_verification.details: All 7 sidebar nav data-testid attributes verified present and visible: nav-dashboard, nav-my schools, nav-my inbox, nav-calendar, nav-find schools, nav-ai-features-toggle, profile-dropdown-trigger
